en_title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Stars: Leon Fever, Crucial Character Moments, and Apocalypse Advice | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
cn_title: 《生化危机：安魂曲》演员谈角色塑造
subtitle: 里昂热潮超乎预料
opus_summary: 《生化危机：安魂曲》两位主演接受IGN采访，分享塑造格蕾丝与里昂的经历及关键场景。他们还谈到玩家对成熟版里昂的狂热反应，并为新电影主角提出末日求生建议。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil has always been huge with gamers, but Resident Evil Requiem is the biggest-selling installment yet. For Fall Fan Fest 2026, IGN spoke to the actors behind Grace Ashcroft and Leon S Kennedy, Angela Sant'Albano and Nick Apostolides about their experiences creating their characters and what they've made of the enthusiastic, and sometimes feral, fan reaction since launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》系列一直深受玩家欢迎，而《生化危机：安魂曲》更是系列迄今销量最高的一作。在2026年秋季粉丝节期间，IGN采访了格蕾丝·阿什克罗夫特和里昂·S·肯尼迪的饰演者Angela Sant'Albano与Nick Apostolides，聊了聊他们塑造角色的经历，以及他们如何看待游戏发售后粉丝热情、有时甚至近乎疯狂的反应。

paragraphs.en: "Nick has been wonderful. He's been like a big brother in a way, kind of guiding me through it all," says Sant'Albano of taking her first step into the world of Resident Evil.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到首次踏入《生化危机》的世界，Sant'Albano说：「Nick特别好。在某种程度上，他就像大哥哥一样，一路带着我熟悉这一切。」

paragraphs.en: "It was hard to sum up what those guys were about to get into," said Apostolides of his role as a series veteran, having starred in the remakes of Resident Evil 2 and 4 and Netflix's Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness.
paragraphs.cn: Apostolides曾出演《生化危机2》和《生化危机4》的重制版，以及Netflix的《生化危机：无尽黑暗》。谈到自己作为系列老将的角色，他说：「很难用几句话向他们说明，他们即将面对什么。」

paragraphs.en: "I knew because of my history with the franchise. I'd already done three projects with it, and I had an intimate understanding of the fan base and how excited and passionate they are. So I was just secretly excited for these guys," he said. "I think I just tried to help everyone understand the grim universe that they were stepping into, because these games are fun, they're campy at times, and yes, they're about zombies and surviving and the apocalypse, but they also have such grounded reality to them. They center around real human stories, and so: not psyching them out, but getting them prepared for what they're about to experience."
paragraphs.cn: 「我知道会是什么样，因为我之前就参与过这个系列。我已经出演过三部相关作品，对粉丝群体有很深入的了解，知道他们有多兴奋、多热情。所以我一直在心里为他们感到兴奋，」他说。「我想，我只是尽量帮助大家理解他们即将踏入的这个残酷世界。这些游戏很好玩，有时还带着夸张戏谑的味道。没错，它们讲的是丧尸、求生和末日，但也有非常扎实的现实根基。它们围绕真实的人性故事展开。所以，我不是要吓唬他们，而是让他们为即将经历的一切做好准备。」

paragraphs.en: Part of what makes Resident Evil Requiem such a stand out for the series are the chracters of Grace, a young woman suddenly faced not just grief, but monsters and the contrast with an older, wiser, veteran of the world, Leon. Apostolides picked out the scene that, for him, really encapsulated the version of Leon that we see in Resident Evil Requiem.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》之所以在系列中如此突出，部分原因在于格蕾丝与里昂这两个角色及其反差。年轻的格蕾丝突然不仅要面对悲痛，还要面对怪物；里昂则年纪更长、更有智慧，早已熟悉这个世界。Apostolides挑出了一场戏，在他看来，这场戏真正概括了《生化危机：安魂曲》中里昂的形象。

paragraphs.en: "There was a scene that really reinforced what Leon is all about. When he's in the garbage dump area with Grace, Grace is sitting by his side, and then he gets up, and Grace asks him, 'You're so sick; why do you keep going? You're not going to make it.' And he just says a few select keywords here: 'I couldn't make a difference back then. But I'm here now, and this is my chance to make a difference.' And that's what he's all about. That's his spine, that's his DNA; he just wants to do the right thing and help those who can't help themselves. He's always been that guy, and even facing the end possibly, he's still doing that."
paragraphs.cn: 「有一场戏让我更加确信，里昂就是这样的人。他和格蕾丝在垃圾场区域，格蕾丝坐在他身边。然后他站起身，格蕾丝问他：「你病得这么重，为什么还要坚持？你撑不下去的。」而他只说了几句关键的话：「当年我没能改变什么。但现在我在这里，这是我做出改变的机会。」这就是他。他的支柱、他的本性就是如此；他只想做正确的事，帮助那些无力自救的人。他一直都是这样的人，即使可能即将走到生命尽头，他也依然在这么做。」

paragraphs.en: For Sant'Albano, the scene that really stood out to her from Grace's story was is her reaction to the death of her mother. "You understand the sort of trauma that she went through. Grace, I think from from birth, is introverted and a little uncomfortable with human contact and all that good stuff. I think from seeing her mother pass away in such a traumatic way, it sort of exacerbated all everything for her," she said.
paragraphs.cn: 对Sant'Albano来说，格蕾丝的故事中最让她印象深刻的，是格蕾丝面对母亲死亡时的反应。她说：「你能理解她经历了怎样的创伤。我觉得格蕾丝从小就很内向，不太适应与人接触，诸如此类。目睹母亲以如此惨烈的方式死去，让她的这些问题都加重了。」

paragraphs.en: "And then the other one , which made me understand Grace's journey and the courage that she had to find, was actually when Emily died, because you understood, first of all, the guilt that Grace had. Because I think there's a line where she literally says again, 'This is how I've done this again. This is all my fault.' And you understand this burden and this guilt that she's carried her whole life.
paragraphs.cn: 「另一个让我理解格蕾丝的历程，以及她必须鼓起怎样的勇气的场景，其实是艾米莉死去的时候。因为首先，你能理解格蕾丝的愧疚。我记得有句台词，她真的又一次说：『我怎么又弄成了这样。这都是我的错。』你能理解她一生都背负着的重担和愧疚。」

paragraphs.en: "That feeling that she let her mom down, and now she's letting this other person she's really grown to love and care about down. But I also think it made it very clear to me of where I had to get to in terms of Grace's journey. She has to stand up for someone else, and even though she's not good at standing up for herself, she has to find that bravery."
paragraphs.cn: 「她觉得自己辜负了母亲，如今又辜负了另一个她已经深深爱上、真心在乎的人。但我也觉得，这让我非常清楚，演绎格蕾丝这段历程时，我需要把她带到怎样的状态。她必须为别人挺身而出，哪怕她不擅长为自己出头，也必须鼓起这份勇气。」

paragraphs.en: The fan base turned out to be especially excited for Leon S. Kennedy this time around. He's always been an attractive male lead, but something about the more mature, slightly grizzled version of him that appeared in Requiem sent certain corners of the internet feral, complete with Instagram thirst traps.
paragraphs.cn: 这一次，粉丝们对里昂·S·肯尼迪表现得格外狂热。他一直是个很有魅力的男主角，但《生化危机：安魂曲》中这个更成熟、略显沧桑的版本，不知为何让部分网友彻底疯狂，连Instagram上都出现了各种秀性感的帖子。

paragraphs.en: "You know, it's funny, I was kind of expecting the status quo. He was always popular. He's a great-looking character. He stands for such good in the world, but it was a whole different level of… What's the word I'm looking for?"
paragraphs.cn: 「你知道吗，说来有趣，我本来以为会和往常差不多。他一直很受欢迎，长得也很帅，还代表着世间那么多美好的东西。但这次完全到了另一个程度的……我想说的那个词是什么来着？」

paragraphs.en: "Okay, it was a whole different level of Leon fever that I was not expecting. It was dialed up to, like, a twelve. And I thought it was going to be, like, a nine, so we'll say that."
paragraphs.cn: 「好吧，这次的里昂热潮完全到了另一个程度，是我没想到的。热度大概被调到了十二，而我以为会是九左右，就这么说吧。」

paragraphs.en: One of the big obsessions after the game was released is that one version of Leon was wearing a wedding ring, but the game didn't reveal who the lucky Mrs. S. Kennedy was. Both stars say they get asked all the time by fans.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏发售后，玩家热议的一大话题是，其中一个版本的里昂戴着婚戒，但游戏并未揭晓那位幸运的S.肯尼迪夫人是谁。两位主演都表示，粉丝经常向他们问起这件事。

paragraphs.en: "They're asking me as if I know," says Apostolides. "I usually just say he's married to you, the fans."
paragraphs.cn: 「他们问我的时候，好像我知道答案似的，」Apostolides说，「我通常只会说，他娶的就是你们这些粉丝。」

paragraphs.en: After the positive reaction to the game and renewed interest, even outside the world of games, thanks to the new movie, what is it about the series that gives it a longevity beyond so many other horror games and zombie stories?
paragraphs.cn: 游戏收获了好评，新电影又让人们重新关注起这个系列，甚至吸引了游戏圈以外的人。那么，究竟是什么让这个系列比许多其他恐怖游戏和丧尸故事更经久不衰？

paragraphs.en: "I feel like Capcom is just dialed in," says Apostolides. "Number one, I think they really, really do listen to the fans. They also know what they're doing. They're extremely talented. And that's what separates the franchises from the ones that survive all these years and the ones that kind of flutter out.
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得卡普空就是很在状态，」Apostolides说，「首先，我认为他们真的非常、非常愿意听取粉丝的意见。他们也清楚自己在做什么，而且才华出众。这就是有些系列能延续这么多年，而另一些却逐渐销声匿迹的区别所在。」

paragraphs.en: "I think it's also a perfect recipe for these projects and these games, where, yes, it's about zombies, killing zombies, stopping world domination from evil corporations, but it's also centered around human stories that — the fans get so attached to these characters, and they feel like they're surviving a huge obstacle together with their friends, with the people that they watch, with the characters. And there's — I think there's a beautiful, like, metaphor to life of just getting through adversity."
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得这些项目、这些游戏也找到了完美的配方。没错，它们讲的是丧尸、杀丧尸、阻止邪恶企业统治世界，但故事的核心也是人。粉丝对这些角色产生了深厚的感情，感觉自己正和朋友、和自己一路关注的人物、和这些角色一起渡过巨大的难关。我觉得这就像一个关于人生的美好比喻，讲的就是如何熬过逆境。」

paragraphs.en: "For me, like, as an actor, when I first read the script, I just felt that the human story is what made the game so addictive," adds Sant'Albano. "And with Leon, just the fact that they managed to create such a beloved character so early on. It's really a testament to the fans of, you know, staying with the game and watching Leon grow older and meet new characters and see where life takes him. But I think creating complex characters like Grace, that's just so delicious for a gamer or for anyone, frankly, in any medium, is to have a really complex character that they can observe."
paragraphs.cn: 「对我来说，作为演员，第一次读剧本时，我就觉得，正是那些关于人的故事让这款游戏如此令人着迷，」Sant'Albano补充道，「再说里昂，他们那么早就成功塑造出了一个如此受人喜爱的角色。粉丝始终陪伴着这款游戏，看着里昂渐渐变老，结识新角色，看看人生会把他带向何方，这本身就很能说明粉丝的支持。但我觉得，塑造格蕾丝这样复杂的角色，让玩家，或者坦白说，让接触任何媒介作品的人，都能观察一个真正复杂的角色，实在是很有吸引力。」

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil is also finding a new audience thanks to the new movie adaptation from horror director Zach Cregger, so what advice would they have for its unlucky hero, Brian, as Resident Evil survivors?
paragraphs.cn: 恐怖片导演Zach Cregger执导的新改编电影也为《生化危机》吸引了新的观众。那么，作为《生化危机》中的幸存者，两位演员会给电影里那位倒霉的主角Brian什么建议呢？

paragraphs.en: "I'd probably say, find your version of Leon," says Sant'Albano. "Find your version of Leon, and try and find more than one bullet if you can, probably."
paragraphs.cn: Sant'Albano说：「我大概会说，找到属于你的里昂。找到属于你的里昂，然后如果可以的话，尽量多找几颗子弹，别只有一颗。」

paragraphs.en: "Find a huge gun," adds Apostolides with a smile.
paragraphs.cn: Apostolides笑着补充道：「找一把大枪。」

paragraphs.en: Sant'Albano is currently playing Hermia in A Midsummer Night's Dream (with added rave culture) at the Chichester Festival Theatre, while also working on adding her vocal talents to the King Arthur-meets-modern-day-apocalypse action-RPG Tides of Annihilation as hero Gwendolyn. Apostolides has a packed calendar too: he just did his first anime dub for Ghost in the Shell, is working on indie action-adventure RPG Emberville, and is developing his own game with his brother, a backyard-type zombie beat 'em up game inspired by his father. During the interview, he pitched an unusual role to Sant'Albano.
paragraphs.cn: Sant'Albano目前正在奇切斯特节日剧院上演的《仲夏夜之梦》中饰演赫米娅，这版演出还融入了锐舞文化。与此同时，她也在为动作RPG《湮灭之潮》的主角格温德琳配音，该作将亚瑟王传说与现代末日背景相结合。Apostolides的日程也排得很满：他刚刚首次为动画配音，参与的作品是《攻壳机动队》；他还在参与独立动作冒险RPG《Emberville》，并与兄弟一起开发自己的游戏。这是一款以父亲为灵感、带有后院风格的丧尸清版动作游戏。采访中，他向Sant'Albano提议了一个不寻常的角色。

paragraphs.en: "You might have to play a zombie animal."
paragraphs.cn: 「你可能得演一只丧尸动物。」

paragraphs.cn: 秋季粉丝节带来90项独家揭晓内容，涵盖游戏、电影、电视、漫画和收藏品。观看IGN直播，即可看到游戏公布消息、预告片、独家片段、明星采访等内容；如果错过了秋季粉丝节的内容，也可以直接在IGN补看。
